description: Break into a cursed mansion, steal everything you can, and escape before the Clown finds you. The Clownhouse is a stealth horror extraction roguelite with no weapons, only hiding, disguises, and nerve. Try the free demo solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Same End Demo
description: Discover Dienna, a young reaper tired of dealing with troubled souls, who prefers to challenge them with trials where their lives are at stake. A platformer and Die and Retry runner game featuring multiple branching paths and alternative endings, hand-drawn in the style of a lightly animated.

title: VOXSHIFT Demo
description: Want to game, stream, or chat with players worldwide without losing your voice? VoxShift translates your speech in real time and plays it back in your own voice — not a robot's. Works with Discord, game chat, and OBS. 10 languages, noise cancellation, and soundboard included. One-time purchase.

title: Don't Lose Your Head Demo
description: Destroy your friendship by playing this challenging co-op game about two skeletons sharing a single head. Help each other to get out of a deep cave, be mindful of your jumps and remember - DON'T LOSE YOUR HEAD!

title: Last One Employed Demo
description: [Demo] Free demo, matches capped at 25 min. A cutthroat party card game for 3–10 players. Sabotage your coworkers, survive your inbox, and be the last one employed. One shared screen; phones are the controllers.

title: Anchor To Live - Demo -
description: ――Making a choice is synonymous with giving up.Raiden, a student harboring suicidal tendencies, skipped school every day, immersing himself in black magic.He cared neither about others nor himself, seeking to change something through black magic.One rainy day, he finally succeeded in a black magic ritual he had never achieved before.

title: RPG Incremental Idle Demo
description: An idle RPG: train 17 skills, master nine weapons, craft your own gear, unlock seven boss-guarded regions, and raise an Estate that works while you sleep — your progress keeps ticking even offline.

title: Bottle Flip Inc Demo
description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

title: Chalk & Blood Demo
description: CHALK & BLOODUn cadáver. Una habitación cerrada. Una sala llena de sospechosos que no piensan hablar. En CHALK & BLOOD no hay armas ni persecuciones: solo tú, la tiza y una verdad escondida en la geometría fría de la escena del crimen. Aquí la lógica es la única arma, y todo asesino comete un error.

title: League Of Transmigrators Demo
description: A roguelike deck-building adventure set across multiple worlds corrupted by unknown forces. Each world offers unique mechanics — from cultivation and martial arts to steampunk machinery and cosmic horror.

title: [Hell is Empty] Demo
description: The demo of [Hell is Empty] , a story-driven first person brawler about a monster fighting his way through a mysterious playground;-- full game release date TBD!

title: 種も仕掛けも思い出も【体験版】
BE QUICK! The Rise of Fraya Demo
description: BE QUICK! The Rise of Fraya Demo is a cinematic boss rush driven by reflexes and QTE combat. Master enemy patterns, hit targets in real time, build combos, upgrade Fraya’s stats and survive the first three increasingly brutal boss battles.

title: Kingdom of Hope - Demo
description: Rise from nine years of tyranny to rebuild a scarred medieval land. As a celebrated hero, you’re granted a farmstead by the new King. Forge a fresh life of growth, craft, and community.

title: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings Demo
description: A romance-driven narrative about destiny, devotion, and the dangerous pull of belonging, set against the ruins of a long‑lost city calling you home.

title: Killdozer Demo
description: Destroy the town! Killdozer is an action roguelike where you bulldoze a town while surviving a police onslaught. Unlock items and upgrades along the way to build your Killdozer into the ultimate destruction machine.

title: Free Ball Demo
description: Free Ball is a third-person arcade volleyball game where every character has unique special abilities. Pass, set, spike, serve, and block your way through intense multiplayer matches that reward teamwork and precision.

title: EVA Awakening Demo
description: A cinematic VR psychological sci-fi journey into memory and consciousness. Solve environmental puzzles and make choices that reshape reality, as the line between creator and creation disappears. "My existence is not a mistake. It is a question."

title: Shotgun Jumper Nano™ Demo
description: Try out the original video game design by Super Amauri, try to stay airborne while shooting your gun in skatepark inspired levels.

title: True Nightmare - Diner Loop Demo
description: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you. Can you escape?

title: A Stray Line Demo
description: Chapter 1 of A Stray Line. Explore a strange world, draw to cast spells, and begin a story about a lonely little family in the woods.

title: PAPER.VOID Demo
description: Pilot a paper plane through an infinite monochrome dimension. Collect VOID Cubes, survive your own deadly trail, and face the END of reality.

title: Rolling Free Demo
description: A grapple-physics 3D platformer. You're a hamster tired of the wheel—so you flee upward, from cage to an antenna that leads to the moon. Swing, accelerate, nail your landings; when you fall, start over. The higher you climb, the heavier it gets. A narrator whispers: giving up is fine, too.

title: Chakab Demo
description: Explore a tropical island, uncover the secrets of an ancient Mayan temple, and survive the curse of Chak’ab. Solve puzzles, make meaningful choices, and face psychological horror in a world where reality and nightmare become one.

title: Something Strange Tonight - The Lurker Demo
description: You came to this house for a one-night babysitting job. As the night goes on, strange events begin to unfold, and nothing is as it seems. Can you protect the little girl and make it through the night alive?

title: Questmonger Demo
description: You are the quest giver. Run a guild from behind the counter: hear the townsfolk's troubles, hire the right hero for the job, and gamble your gold on their gear. Heroes die. Rent is due. The Crown is watching.

title: HueTrix Demo
description: HueTrix is a colorful block-stacking puzzle with a roguelike twist: clear lines to earn cash, then spend it in the shop on powerful mythic relics. Chain combos across seven colors, stack permanent upgrades, and build a game-breaking run. Easy to learn, endlessly deep, full controller support.ㄴ

title: Hunters Trial : One Breath Demo
description: Fixed-position, scope-only hunting. One position, one breath, one shot. Read the wild, hold your breath, and take the perfect shot across 40 trials in three biomes. Unlock 8 rifles, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

title: Code: Infinity Demo
description: After being trapped in an infinite world, I was entangled by seven men?

title: FLINTWILDE Demo
description: Let your character explore, fight, and survive on their own with auto-crafting recipes and proper gears In a 1-BIT monochrome world — a desktop idle RPG built around monster collection and character building.

title: A Knight's Fury - The Vaults of Venom Demo
碧海六重奏 Demo
description: You are a hero who saved the world, but you were killed by your own bride. Who is the mastermind behind the six girls surrounding you? Survival & Love Suspense AVG!

title: Evergreen Clicker Demo
description: Grow a thriving forest in this cozy incremental clicker. Plant trees, unlock upgrades, weather the changing seasons, trigger Forest Renewal, and build an ever-stronger woodland that keeps growing even while you’re away.

title: bansoko: Class Crossing Demo
description: An RPG-inspired companion puzzle game. Your commands reach your companions with a delay. Then class change with adorable outfits!

title: Forestless Demo
description: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure that takes you on a journey through the world of fear, armed only with the magical arrow of hope. Explore the vastness of human nightmares, from the foggy lands of loneliness to the mountains of failure.

title: Blue Guy Must Die Demo
description: Free demo of BLUE GUY MUST DIE — survive a short Forest run of auto-fire combat, upgrades, toxic bugs, and a boss fight. Then jump into Early Access for the full mission.

title: Escape the Exomoon Demo
description: ESCAPE THE EXOMOON is a narrative driven cyberpunk sci-fi horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

title: MOTA Demo
description: MOTA is a top-down survival horror game set in a surreal, endless maze. Outrun the monsters hunting you in the dark and escape by elevator, floor by floor. Grab random items, deal with rules that change on every floor, and push for the end of a maze that never looks the same twice.

title: MASSFALL Demo
description: Play a curated 12-stage slice of MASSFALL. Weld physical parts onto your ball to change its shape, weight, center of gravity, and bounce, then descend through varied pinball wells, build HEAT, bank it into SCORE, and face three escalating bosses.

title: VEINFORGE Demo
description: Mine coal, copper, tin, iron, and silver in timed expeditions, recruit assistants to gather materials, then return to the forge to smelt, hammer, quench, and sell equipment. Unlock mining and smithing upgrades through the complete incremental loop of VEINFORGE Demo.

title: AquaDesk Demo
description: AquaDesk is a relaxing aquarium simulation that turns your desktop into a living home for tropical fish. Feed, care for, breed, and discover unique fish through genetics and unlock new features as your calm desktop aquarium grows.

title: KILLPHRASE Demo
description: TYPE TO TERMINATE. Descend into a mechanical abyss and face waves of hostile machines. Choose your path and fight to the end of the line, or fall beneath the metal tide.

title: Group Idlemen Demo
description: Train Skills to 99, take on key bosses for RARE LOOT, Raids, & Expeditions. Control all 5 people in your group and climb the leaderboards!

title: The Fire Must Be Fed Demo
description: A short incremental game about feeding a mysterious fire. Harvest the forest around you and bring it resources, the more you sacrifice, the more power you gain. Unlock devastating fire powers and uncover what the fire really wants.

title: COLD AISLE: Data Center Tycoon Demo
Heretic's Rapture - DEMO
description: Hell is overpopulated and demons are escaping to Earth. Build a tower out of tetris-like shapes to create powerful synergies and send escaped souls back to hell, where they belong.

title: Naughty Nurse Demo
description: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 3 - Single Player Demo
description: Welcome to the biggest ship graveyard in the world! Check out what awaits you in the game and try the Demo version - grab your hammer, start up the heavy machinery, and experience the ultimate shipbreaking. Explore a living town, hire workers to expand your ship graveyard!

title: A Tiny Wander Demo
description: An exploration mystery adventure where the setting and narrative become the riddle. Hurry through the night, lantern in hand. And occasionally respite with a cup of coffee. Explore, discover, gather insight from interactions, delivering your parcel to the farthest reaches of the forest.

title: Rubber Bird Demo
description: Meet Rub the bird and help him answer the big question: why does he have arms? Jump, stretch, grab, throw, and mess up everything around you in this bite-sized physics-based platformer.

title: Destroy Buildings With Missiles Demo
description: An incremental physics-based destruction game. Destroy buildings to earn money. Spend money to upgrade your arsenal. Destroy some more buildings.

title: Sandcastle Demo
description: On a sun-warmed tropical shore, quietly craft a mighty sandcastle. Carve moats, raise towers and walls, then embellish with driftwood, pebbles, shells and seaweed. Gentle tides, soft surf and a calming color palette turn every build into a peaceful, relaxing moment. This is the demo for Sandcastle.

title: Beastfolk Barber Demo
description: You're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.

title: Words Of Power Demo
description: Words of Power is a fill-in-the-blank rogue like deck builder. Construct sentences of devastating power and manipulate the sentences of your foes to turn the tides of battle!

title: Marblearium Demo
description: Experience approximatly 30 minutes of Marblearium, a flow-based marble adventure with satisfying physics and laid-back lo-fi beats. Steer a marble through nostalgic, interconnected tracks. Collect unique marbles and unlock new paths as the world grows stranger. Sometimes turbulent, always relaxing.

title: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss Demo
Flight Date Demo
description: A cozy logic puzzle game where you plan trips to reunite people in different cities. Characters’ requests and limited flight options make things more challenging. Create the best routes for everyone, unlock new cities, and enjoy a warm and relaxing journey.

title: Beards Go Underground Demo
description: The Mining Deckbuilder. Blow up the mountains using explosive card combos! Build your deck, prepare your strategy and BOOM! - call gold and gemstones your own.

title: Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears Prologue
description: Play an exclusive standalone prologue set after Rainbow Billy: The Curse of the Leviathan and immediately before The Book of Fears. Help Billy investigate strange events, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets before the ferry leaves for Camp Meteor.

title: Last Round at the End of the World
The Idle Captain Demo
description: A pirate idle RPG that runs as an overlay on your desktop. Sail between locations, fish, craft goods, brew, trade at the marketplace, and battle enemies while leveling up fishing, combat, and sailing skills in the background.

title: Little Sheep Valley Demo
description: Tend to a flock of sheep and build your perfect Mediterranean farm in this cozy ranch-builder! Decorate, expand, and create the perfect home for your fluffy friends. Yes, you can cuddle them.

title: Tony The Mole Demo
description: Play as Tony, a curious little mole with a serious digging habit, a taste for worms, and a dream of reaching the surface. Help townsfolk, repair gadgets, collect delightful hats, and explore hidden spaces as you uncover the story of Pebblegrove.

title: Ice Pond: An Ice Fishing Adventure Demo
description: Set in a whimsical snowy world inhabited by friendly creatures, Ice Pond: An Ice Fishing Adventure offers cozy yet strategic ice‑fishing with smooth pacing, rewarding fish fights, and light RPG elements. Manage your gear and pick your bait in a relaxing experience where every catch feels meaningful.

title: INURE Demo
description: Wrong man, in the wrong place, at the wrong time. Explore a hostile Dreamscape, manage scarce resources, and use whatever weapons you can find to survive a world shaped by cosmic dread.

title: DICEBONE Demo
description: You will not Die Today. You will Dice ! Control the Chaos, Escape the Ossuary, Or be part of the Bones... Forever.

title: Travelling Light Demo
description: Travelling Light is a narrative game about four friends, Lars, Leah, Samson, and Ivy, caught in the turbulence of their early thirties. Inspired by real events, this experience lets you step into each perspective as love, friendship, and heartbreak collide.

title: Feed Me Harvest Demo
description: "Feed Me Harvest" is a first person horror farming game set in a eerie location. Plant crops, harvest , and feed the hungry head nearby to earn money. Use your rewards to buy upgrades, unlock seeds, and survive the night long enough to grow the key to your escape.

title: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~ Demo
description: Dragon's Chroniclesシリーズは、シミュレーションRPGの伝統へのリスペクトと進化をテーマに掲げた本格派中世ハードコアSRPGです。伝統に基づいたオーセンティックな設計と、プレイヤーそれぞれの攻略や編成がゆるされる自由度の高い何でもアリの高い戦略性が好評を博しています。

title: 8bit Salvage Demo
description: Scrub old game art. Save the pixels. Clean through chaos. A calm, oddly satisfying incremental cleaning game: scrub the pixels off retired sprites with a spinning brush, cash in the salvage, and upgrade a tiny shop until tidy cleanup builds into a glorious storm.

title: Expedition: Into Darkness Demo
description: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval coop extraction looter. Craft weapons, customize gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

title: Echo Zero Demo
description: Descend into a dangerous, sci-fi underworld in this tower defense roguelike. Explore, gather resources, uncover powerful wargear and upgrades, build and defend your base, and battle a mysterious new species.

title: A Blind Step Demo
description: The Cult of the Flesh sacrifices people every 10 years. The Flesh consumes the victim and their memories of the world, thereby discerning exactly what its followers must do to solve their problems. However, by becoming dependent on the Flesh, they lose their cognitive freedom forever.

title: Frogs Aren't Fresh Demo
description: Frogs Aren't Fresh is a cozy, logic puzzle game, where you complete increasingly complex laundry orders! Take your time, and figure out the placement order to make sure everyone gets their clothes the way they like them.

title: Budget Defense Demo
description: During the day, he personally drove the war vehicle to attack the enemy. At night, he extracted oil to sell and use the money to build defense towers, working together to protect the base.

title: Wild n Chill Demo
description: Wild n Chill is a laid-back wilderness escape where ya forage, hunt, and craft the off-grid cabin of your dreams. Far from the noise and nonsense, it’s just you, your trusty companion, and a pal or two.

title: Medieval Fantasy Blacksmith Shop Demo
description: A simple and enjoyable blacksmithing game set in a fantastical medieval shop. Manage your materials, forge swords, and try to pay your weekly rent and survive by selling the right weapons to the adventurers who come to your shop!

title: System Grid Crusher Demo
description: System Grid Crusher is an isometric cyberpunk survival game set in a neon rift: the horde presses in, your weapon fires on its own, and you collect power-ups and build your loadout longer than anyone else. So, are we stacking single-target damage or going full AoE?

title: Void Incremental Demo
description: An Incremental game about Killing enemies and Mining ores.

title: Magical Girl: incremental gaiden Demo
description: Short incremental Bullet Hell about Magical Girl! Fight against Shadows, gather resources, upgrade skill tree and defeat all the Witches to save humanity!

title: Stream Toolkit - Streaming Tools & Chat Translation Demo
description: A streaming toolbox built for content creators. Features real-time chat translation, translation subtitles, live polls, giveaways, goal bars, donation tools, timers, and more. Supports Steam Workshop themes and full CSS customization, with a dedicated OBS URL for every feature.

title: Sandbox Jianghu: Walk My Own Path Demo
description: A living MUD-inspired Jianghu simulator featuring ATB combat, dual Sect/Faction social systems, dynamic weather, and reincarnation mechanics. Play via GUI or classic text commands.

title: Chocolate Parade / チョコレートパレード Demo
赌石之王 Demo
description: 《赌石之王》是一款的休闲模拟经营游戏，在游戏之中玩家将面对各种翡翠的原石，玩家在游戏之中需要不断的刮开翡翠的表面，从中你开出的翡翠都是不同的，制作各个大小的翡翠，进行出售，赚取更多的金币。试玩版只提供第一关的挑战，想要更高更难的挑战请关注游戏的正式版。

title: That pricing man 定价人 Demo
description: In this game, you play as an apprentice at a civilian trading post in 1918. As one three-day cycle follows another, you will gradually confront the desperate situation you find yourself in. Buy and resell supplies, and do whatever it takes to survive until the required number of days has passed.

title: Frost-Buried Truth Demo
description: Frost-Buried Truth is a first-person survival horror game. Trapped in a mysterious lab with no way to fight back, you must sneak, hide, and escape pursuit to find your only way out. The 30-minute demo includes all of level one and part of level two, without the full ending. Saves won't carry over.

title: Immerse Gamepack Cyberpunk 2077 Demo
description: Immerse Gamepack Cyberpunk 2077 expands Night City’s soundscape around and above you in every direction with unprecedented realism and accuracy.

title: Where the Veil Thins Demo
description: A shortened version of Act 1 of 'Where The Veil Thins'. You have accelerated EXP gain, and are exposed to many of the core systems.

title: The Island of Jiji Demo
description: After losing his job, Hu Yi drifts into Jiji Island, where an old scammer, a boy obsessed with love, a meat-eating monk, and a girl named Yan become part of his life. Days pass between beaches, salt fields... until he can no longer avoid the question: What kind of life do I want to live?

title: LEVEL TEST Demo
description: Level Test is an action roguelike game with free‑build customization. Players can freely choose their weapons and skills, then select branching paths and upgrades to challenge random bosses.

title: Peaceful Bug Catching Story Demo
description: Pick up your bug net and set off on a grand summer adventure. Your bug-collecting summer vacation is about to begin!

title: SummonFall Demo
description: Fight through the opening three floors of SummonFall, a single-player fantasy action RPG built around fast combat, loot, summons, and buildcraft.Survive escalating enemy waves, defeat each floor’s boss, and collect rewards that make your next build stronger.

title: Hazard Suits Demo
description: Demo for HAZARD SUITS. A 1-4 player co-op, arcade shooter, with split-screen! Acid rain, procedurally-generated maps, and endless waves of zombified robots. Explore abandoned facilities, acquire new loot, survive!

title: Synapse Demo
description: Play the opening chapter of Synapse - a cyberpunk hybrid point & click visual novel. Your Rank is collapsing, eviction is close, and one illicit job could change everything. Hack, bargain, and choose whom to trust in a city where every feeling is measured.

title: Axis Flip Demo
description: Physics based Arena Shooter. Up is down. Adapt or die.

title: Toey Weedz Smoke One Demo
description: The world is full of D!cks, and only Toey Weedz can stop them! Chill around the yard (Level 0), then blast your way through a sewer overrun by D!cks (Level 4) in this free retro stoner-trash demo. A 100% handmade indie experience by Tobias Alexander Knobloch!

title: Sheeple Demo
description: The Sheeple are moving, and they won't stop for anything. Not walls, not traps, and definitely not common sense. In the Demo for this chaotic puzzle-platformer, you don't control the player, you control the world.

title: Backyard Bayou Demo
description: Don't you hate it when horrors beyond human comprehension show up in the backyard? Grab the shotgun and clear them out. A fast, aggressive third-person roguelite shooter where items stack into ridiculous builds and the swamp never runs out of things to shoot.

title: I Was a Failed Day Trader Who Lost Everything, But After Being Reincarnated in Another World, My Textbook Technical Analysis Actually Works and Now I'm the Richest Man in the Kingdom!? Demo
description: A failed day trader dies at 3:47 a.m. and wakes in a world where his textbook technical analysis actually works. Get rich, get famous, get hunted. A visual novel about candlesticks, courage, and one very patient whale. This is not financial advice.

title: Cult of the Red Heifer Demo
Lilifel Demo
description: High roll your way through an everchanging dungeon in this rune-building, turn-based dungeon crawler. Fight enemies using your elemental runes to conjure powerful spells. Synergize your elements as you loot items that combo with just about everything. Ever Low roll? Just SLAM your way out of it!

title: Lulu Dimensional Leaper Demo
description: Welcome to the "Lulu Dimensional Leaper" demo! Enjoy fast-paced, easy-to-pick-up 2D warp action and play all the way through the first boss battle. Meet Lulu's friends, enjoy their lively conversations, and work together to conquer each stage!

title: The Devil's Ledger Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder about greed. Pay off the Devil's debt before your soul runs out — but the only way to earn enough is to sign more contracts that devour it. Floor the gas, ride the brake, and damn yourself richer.

title: REELS of the DAMNED Demo
description: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

title: The Bandits of Sierra Fria Demo
Gloom Delve Demo
description: The free demo of GloomDelve: the first 10 floors of the Mad Wizard's 100-floor dungeon, boss fight included. Draft game-breaking power cards, solo or in online / split-screen co-op. Nothing's watered down, it just stops at floor 10. The wizard narrates your descent. He isn't impressed.

title: Ants Took the Kitchen Demo
description: In Ants Took the Kitchen, you lead a small colony of ants determined to take over the kitchen. Collect crumbs, carry increasingly larger pieces of food, buy upgrades for each area, automate the collection process, and turn a simple corner of the floor into a hungry swarm.

title: Parallel Self Demo
description: A boy and his shadow. That's all it seemed to be. A challenging one-button 2D action game. On your second run, the whole truth is revealed.

title: Wordventures: The Vampire Pirate Demo
description: On the night of the full moon, a handful of children have seemingly disappeared in the sleepy seaside town of Mistyvale Oaks. Solve word search puzzles to track down leads, uncover clues, and solve the mystery of the ghost ship in this narrative puzzle adventure game.

title: Little Lua & The Lost Six Demo
description: Lua's parents were spirited away to a world of magic and enchanted sleep. Lead a band of pint-sized heroes on a warm, story-driven rescue: cast spells, master clever squad formations, and bring one family home. A gentle roguelike with a difficulty for every age.

title: Red Echoes: Berlin Demo
description: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

title: YoiNekoAn: The Seven Tails Demo
description: Anime-style real-time third-person dungeon RPG featuring a party of seven. Explore dangerous dungeons and fight alongside your companions in this action RPG.

title: Siege Masters Demo
description: Build. Summon. Dominate. In Siege Masters, defense is only half the battle. Facing off against three rivals, you must balance fortifying your base with assaulting enemy lines. Every wall you place shapes the fate of the monsters, and every monster you send out determines your fate.

title: The Last Train: End of the Line Demo
Tuned In: The Prologue
description: A cursed TV holds you captive. To break free, survive the dark entity's programs of mind-bending puzzles, terror, and impossible choices, as reality and the broadcast slowly bleed into one another.

title: Bōlíng: Beyond Samsara
description: BOLING – Physics‑driven action roguelite. Grappling‑hook traversal + Dota‑style equipment crafting. Break free as a sentient soul fragment, master the Five Elements, and reclaim your body. Free demo available now. Add to wishlist.

title: The Library Assistant Demo
description: The Library Assistant is a cozy book-sorting game where you'll discover over 3,000 books across 600 unique book collections. Organize shelves, uncover charming literary treasures, and experience the satisfying feeling of bringing order to delightful physics-based chaos.

title: Shelve the Potions! Demo
description: Shelve the Potions! Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols, decipher cryptic notes, and uncover the correct shelf orders in a cozy organizational simple puzzle game.

title: Scrap Snap Demo
description: Embark on a journey with the Android! Sneak into resource-rich areas and dismantle resources while the Android protects you. Upgrade the Android to keep you safe for longer. Upgrade your dismantling level to dismantle resources more easily!

title: Gomoklear Demo
description: Gomoklear is asymmetric Gomoku roguelike—connect five to clear the line and reshape the board. No more slow defensive stalemates: spawn, remove, transform… play pieces with unique powers and rack up lines before the Round Limit ends. Gomoku has never been this unpredictable.

title: Ultimate Blacksmith Tycoon　~鑑定スキル持ちの店長が、鍛冶屋経営で無双する~ Demo
description: An appraiser-shopkeeper conquers the blacksmith trade. Read materials, decode Modifiers, bend the rarity table. Craft gear (Artifact 1 in 1,270), arm adventurers across 79 jobs, and dispatch parties into dungeons of 1,270+ monsters. Compound-interest debt, a re-forging workshop, 80+ tech nodes.

title: Zone Sweeper Demo
description: Free demo of Zone Sweeper — a fast RPG of short runs, hand-picked stats, and levels that explode in a single fight. Sweep a risk-colored zone grid, auto-battle, gear up, and research in the Lab.

title: DevilInThePenthouse Demo
description: Slay bosses and climb the demonic skyscraper in this stress-free incremental RPG. Gather loot, unleash powerful active skills, and upgrade your knight to achieve ultimate power. Can you reach the Penthouse and defeat the Devil?

title: The Dark Realms of Chrysalis Demo
description: Welcome to the pre-alpha demo of The Dark Realms of Chrysalis. Explore a dark fantasy world, meet its first characters, and experience the atmosphere of an RPG still in development. Your feedback will help shape the journey ahead.

title: Black Hollow Demo
description: Become the doctor the plague fears. Black Hollow is a first-person dark-fantasy horde-survival roguelite where you slaughter infected hordes, harvest their ichor, and forge devastating builds before the next bell toll.

title: Green Field Cube Island Demo
description: Green Field Cube Island is a 3D action RPG. Step into the role of Chodnii, cross the mysterious teleportation portals scattered across Cube Island, explore wildly different worlds, hone your skills, defeat dangerous enemies, and ultimately find a way to escape Cube Island.

title: Roll to Ruin Demo
description: Roll to Ruin is a medieval dice roguelite. Roll, hold, bank or farkle — Farkle rules with a deckbuilding twist. Battle through seven taverns, build your dice deck, wield 34 badges to flip the table. Outscore your rival or lose it all. Dice are fate. Every wager counts. Just one more... right?

title: Farm Hand Demo
description: A cozy roguelike deckbuilder about creating huge harvest combos! Draft new seeds, discover game-changing synergies, and carefully plan your harvests to maximize your score! Every crop has a timer. Every harvest is a puzzle. Every combo feels incredible.

title: N.E.O.N. HORIZON Demo
description: Survive 100 increasingly dangerous waves in a sci-fi roguelite shooter where every decision shapes your ship. Upgrade your systems, discover powerful relics, forge unique synergies, and uncover the mystery that awaits beyond the Horizon.

title: Dawnhold Demo
description: Dawnhold is a top-down action base-defense game where you gather resources, build up your defenses, and survive relentless enemy waves. Strike back by assaulting enemy strongholds and defeating powerful bosses in a fight to protect the Sunstone.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds Prologue Demo
description: Monster Hunter Wilds Prologue Demo allows you to enjoy the game from the prologue up until you complete the ‘To the Forest’ mission.

title: Nightgate Defense Demo
description: Idle progression meets castle defense. As night falls, monsters pour from the Summoning Gate. Command hundreds of archers and four heroes to hold the last wall!

title: Cats & Rhythmical Restaurant Demo
description: A cozy cat restaurant that lives on your desktop and comes alive to whatever you're listening to. While sound plays, your cats head out for fish, cook, and serve hungry guests; when it's quiet, they get bored and doze off. Recruit cats, dress them up, and grow your seaside diner.

title: BAENANA Demo
description: BAENANA is a fast top‑down bullet‑hell arena shooter where fruit heroes blast waves of corrupted veggies. Equip up to 2 weapons and 4 powerups, auto‑firing by default, and collect coins and gems to build powerful roguelike setups and survive chaotic action.

title: Facrobry Demo
description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

title: Hollow Demo
description: Descend into a procedurally generated dungeon beneath the cursed town of Gravesend Hollow. Battle undead and demons, collect powerful randomized loot, and experience the opening chapter of this dark fantasy action RPG inspired by classic dungeon crawlers.

title: SUPER STARS Demo
description: Build your duo in this casual sports game and battle hordes of enemies as you prepare to challenge the final boss.

title: Typing Show Demo
description: Learn typing in a musical rhythm game with endlessly generated melodies. Each note of the melody turns into a letter. Instead of writing text, practice as if you were playing the piano in a band.

title: Realm Tycoons Demo
description: Build a fantasy realm in this in-game eight-week strategy demo. Explore the board, capture cities, mines, Capitals, and Strongholds, recruit armies, cast spells, and defeat rival rulers through clever realm management and tactical battles.

title: DUMMY HOUSE Demo
description: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.

title: Apocalipsis Survivor Demo
description: Free demo of Apocalipsis Survivor. The first 4 complete worlds with their 12 stages, Survival and Waves modes, 3 characters and 10 weapons with evolutions. Hold off ever denser hordes, until the infected start shooting back.

title: Fire Vow: Dark Fantasy Demo
description: A dark fantasy card-based survival game. Explore the cursed land, gather resources, craft tools, manage hunger and thirst, and survive through difficult choices. Every decision—from who to help to who to kill—shapes your journey.

title: XENOFALL Demo
description: XENOFALL Demo — a single-player sci-fi anime action roguelite. Choose between 2 hunters, slash and shoot through 2 alien-infested maps, collect build-defining gear, and take down 2 colossal bosses. Play free, then wishlist the full game.

title: 3 Switch Problem Demo
description: A casual, 3D, observation and puzzle game. In this demo, flip switches and observe results to answer which switch is controlling an apparatus as you complete the first challenge of the 3-Switch Problem Puzzle Park. Talk to other kids who are also starting their way through the park.

title: Silkroad Defenders: Hunter Manager Demo
description: Get ready for an adventure where you travel across lands to protect caravans. Assemble your team as the leader of the Hunters' Guild. Your party and tower compositions and your boost decisions will determine the destiny of Silk Road.

title: Fuel Sort Demo
description: This is a free demo of the Fuel Sort puzzle game with 30 levels. You sort colored fuel cells into canisters. Select a canister to pick up the top cells, then select another to drop them. You can only drop onto the same color or into an empty canister. Complete the level by sorting all colors into separate canisters.

title: BLIGHTFALL Demo
description: BLIGHTFALL is a fast-paced first-person horde shooter for 1–4 players. Fight through escalating stages on a neon-lit alien world, stack powerful loot, charge shrines under pressure, defeat massive bosses, and loop back with rising difficulty. Solo or online co-op.

title: 500 FINGER FILLET Demo
description: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

title: Game Breaker: Divine Error (Demo)
description: Game Breaker is a humorous, story-driven dark fantasy RPG with a massive 119-track original soundtrack, where every character knows they're in a video game. Exploit glitches and cheats to rewrite the game as you like. Play the free demo now and experience the first 1-2 hours!

title: Ruffed Up Demo
description: Ruffed Up is a chaotic co-op physics game where you play as dogs dragging your unconscious dog walker back home. Team up with 2–4 players online to keep your human safe, cross treacherous terrain, dodge hazards, and somehow get everyone home in one piece. It’s no walk in the park!

title: Mining Away! Demo
description: Mining Away! is a short incremental game in which you mine ores, collect resources, progress through the vast skill tree, find rare relics, and unlock powerful pickaxes!

title: Portal Time Traveller Demo
description: Welcome to your first test as 247th subject in mysterious laboratory. In this special demo, you'll step through a time portal into the Primordial Age, fighting your way through colossal dinosaurs or trying to survive stealthily.

title: Loop Defense: Acquisition Protocol Demo
description: A sci-fi tower defense built around loadouts, base economy, and careful placement. Bring a limited set of tools into each mission, build a defense that works under pressure, and keep the core alive against increasingly dangerous enemy forces.

title: Starving Shadows Demo
description: Starving Shadows is a dark fantasy rpg where you must devour your enemies, but every meal changes you.

title: MC not romancing LIs Demo
description: Play as a reluctant otome game protagonist who'd rather be a spectator than a participant. Fend off advances from a persistent kouhai, a mysterious senpai, and a new transfer student. Will you stick to your shipping principles, or accidentally fall into a romance of your own?

title: Hexzen Demo
description: A hexagonal logic puzzle game set against shifting skies. Play the first region of the handmade campaign and come back for a daily puzzle.

title: Sa[meow]rai: Silverwing Stray Demo
description: "Sa[meow]rai" is a top down action role-playing game centered around one-hit kills and rich interactivity.You play as a law-enforcer with an implant called "Gyakugawa Emergency Reboot Device," fighting for every second of your remaining time in a morally ambiguous cyberpunk city.

title: Mini Mart Survivors Demo
description: A convenience store roguelite. Survive 10-minute night shifts at SHIFT24, where ramen, snacks and coffee are your weapons. Fight off strange customers across 6 branches worldwide, pay down your debt, and find out what the store really is.

title: Hollow Hours - Cheap House Demo
description: Seeking a fresh start, 25-year-old Ethan buys a quiet house with his savings. But as the sun sets, heavy silence, a strange neighbor, and a forbidden second floor reveal a terrifying truth: some fresh starts come at a horrifying cost.

title: Sack Investigation Demo
description: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

title: WHAT NUMBER? Demo
description: High difficulty. Fast retries. Can you control your fingers when they move on their own? Press the numbers in order. Don’t press the wrong number. One mistake, and you start over from 0.

title: 2 Etoiles sont nées Demo
description: Discover the demo of 2 Étoiles sont nées : explore three levels shaped by emotions, either solo or in local co-op. Solve puzzles, battle strange machines, and reverse gravity. Add the game to your wishlist to follow its development.

title: Babylonian Twins Demo
description: Try the free demo of Babylonian Twins — the lost puzzle-platformer made in Baghdad in 1994, remastered in 2026. Freeze one twin to stone while the other dashes, drills and battles through the opening levels. Then wishlist the full five-world adventure.

title: Vanguard Valiants Demo
description: Reclaim the lands taken by the Zahar. Build and lead armies to recover the villages seized by the enemy. Acquire better weapons and manage your soldiers throughout the liberation campaign.

title: Drone Orbit: An Incremental Space Mining Drift Demo
What the Buck?! Demo
description: What the Buck?! is an incremental game about destroying money. Smash stacks of cash, upgrade your destructive power, discover game-changing skill tree upgrades, prestige and experience the dopamine of numbers exploding.

title: H.O.A Simulator Demo
description: HOA Sim is a comedic suburban patrol game where you enforce neighborhood rules as an overzealous homeowners association officer. Cruise the streets, inspect properties, issue citations, and chase your daily fine quota while balancing speed, accuracy, and pure petty power.

title: The Scarlet Thread Demo
description: The Prologue and Chapter One, complete and unabridged. Settle a seating plan by the real rules of a Victorian table, open a locked keepsake with a three-part word riddle, weigh the household's testimony on the deduction board. Play ends with Chapter One; your save carries into the full game.

title: IRREVERENCE Demo
description: IRREVERENCE is a fast paced top down shooter. Run, shoot, and dive into intense combat with a variety of strange foes in this quirky hotline miami like.

title: NonSense Demo
description: Demo: Defeat nightmare shadows and restore senses to help Fran navigate through pain and reconnect with everyday life in this cute-dark 2D narrative adventure RPG.

title: Keep Printing Demo
description: A game where you manage a 3D printing business. Print products, run a shop, buy upgrades, and grow your operation to pay off your debt and earn your freedom.

title: Incremental Pain Profit Demo
description: Click, topple and profit! Knock over tiny wandering Humans, hire Animals to cause chaos, collect mountains of coins and grow your ridiculous empire. Unlock powerful Rebirth upgrades, defeat Bosses and turn a peaceful board into a glorious mess of falling people.

title: Sicarius Demo
description: Embark on a sci-fi roguevania as Sicarius, the ultimate assassin spider bot, where you craft devastating weaponry from scrap and hunt down 70+ unique mechs in procedurally generated levels. Customize your chassis and decide to dismantle the system or serve it.

title: The Last Admiral Demo
description: Command a fleet of warships in turn-based tactical battles. This free demo takes you through the opening stretch of a procedural galaxy: build an Allied fleet, win fights, upgrade your ships, and hold the line in a scripted final stand. You are the Last Admiral.

title: The Rouge Casino Demo
description: Play Roulette Rouge through four antes in this standalone demo. Rig the wheel, beat Small, Big and Boss blinds, and shop for charms, omens, vouchers and packs. The full game adds seven more tables, eight-ante runs, higher stakes, challenges, variants and Endless mode.

title: The Smoothie Shop Demo
description: You are the new owner of The Smoothie Shop. Now it's your turn to keep the family's business alive. In endless rain, you must work the night shift and serve smoothies to your customers. But the shop isn't the only thing you inherited.

title: 蒸汽传奇 Demo
description: *Idle Vapor Legends* is an idle RPG focused on AFK combat and effortless loot collection.

title: Strato Demo
description: Strato is an arcadey aerial combat arena shooter with rogue-lite elements. Take to the skies in a variety of aircraft, armed with a range of weaponry and special abilities. Zap, blast and smash your way through swarms of enemies, survive and thrive on your way to master the stratosphere in Strato!

title: Hi-Fi Roller Demo
description: Roll, jump, and race through a tinkerer’s workshop turned obstacle course. Master a vast miniature world of circuit boards, wires, and contraptions in this photo-realistic marble platformer built for skill and precision.

title: Survive to Save Demo
description: Surviving is not enough. You have to save the world. You might be its last hope. Immerse yourself in a text-based survival game set in a zombie apocalypse, where every decision shapes the story. Survive the outbreak, reach the lab, and become humanity’s last chance.

title: DEADBOOT Demo
description: DEADBOOT is a fast-paced retro roguelike FPS. Blast through randomized levels, scavenge weapons and upgrades along the way, and see how far you can make it in this neon death zone.

title: Vagabones Demo
description: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

title: Cyber Rail Demo
description: Cyber Rail is a frenetic roguelike FPS with robot cowboys, speedy parkour, and devastating synergies. Grapple, slide, and swing as you hunt down enemy bandits on your flying train.

title: Wild Hive Demo
description: Build your own bee hive in this cozy roguelite. Hatch worker bees, forage nectar and sell your honey on the stock market. The royal crown demands more honey every year! Will your hive thrive or fall apart?

title: Hibera Requiem for the Forgotten Demo
Echoes of Kyria Demo
description: Fight solo or with up to 4 players co-op to take on massive bosses in this stylized 3D action rogue-like survivors-like. Step into Kyria, battle against relentless hordes, and master the dynamic, fast-paced combat.

title: Barnburners Demo
description: Arcade hockey like the '90s and '00s used to make, free to try. Four clubs, huge hits, and fights where you throw every punch, on the couch or online. You'll score in the first minute. Getting good is the hard part. The full game adds the other 20 clubs and franchise.

title: Christopher Ledger: Corporate Auditor Demo
description: Anime courtroom murder mystery, set in the corporate world. Interrogate executives, expose billion-dollar cover-ups, and audit your way to the truth.

title: Toy Worlds Atlas Demo
description: Toy Worlds Atlas is a colouring book game that explores philosophy through bizarre, artistic sandbox levels. Combine colours to solve riddles and discover secrets! Made for mindful breaks, each level subverts expectations and inspires thought. Comes with a desktop companion mode for work sessions

title: WheelJumper: The Art Of Edging Demo
Impossible Wonders Demo
description: Oversee a horde of tiny imps as they haphazardly build monuments in the imp lords honor. A cute and short arcade style game with a global leaderboard.

title: Angel Guardian Demo
description: Angel Guardian is a sci-fi side-scrolling action shooter set in a space station under attack. Play as Kita, a warrior guardian on a mission to rescue the young prince while fighting hostile enemies. Use shooting, stealth and hacking to face powerful bosses and prove yourself as a true guardian.
